queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Stretchly %' AND publisher = 'Jan Hovancik';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Stretchly %' AND publisher = 'Jan Hovancik' AND version_compare(version, '1.22.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'stretchly.exe');
